Changes in 0.10.1:
- Added CALC MAX HOLD and MIN HOLD modes using TinySA calc max/calc min.
- Added PAUSE/RESUME to freeze live spectrum updates and waterfall scrolling.
- Paused state remains visible in the status line.
- Added session MAX EVER peak tracking with dBm and frequency.
- MAX EVER marker is drawn on both the spectrum and waterfall.
- MARKER menu now shows MAX EVER prominently with a RESET MAX button.
- Live cellular poll interval reduced from 2 seconds to 1 second.
- Includes 0.10.0 visual redesign and all earlier hardware fixes.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- Manual markers M1-M4 remain available below MAX EVER in the MARKER tab.
